pages.title: Nubik: Create Your Place
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Design a block-built game in Nubik: Create Your Place. Choose its type, construct a level, and position the Nubik spawn points before playing. Try the result alone, with a friend, or let bots explore it while you watch how the created layout works.

pages.title: Perfect Tidy
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Work through a collection of cleanup tasks in Perfect Tidy. Click and drag tools to wash cars, provide skin or pet care, and fix teeth during the different activities. Each scene presents another set of objects to clean, organize, or treat.

pages.title: Alien Wreckage 1
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Search distant space for artifacts in Alien Wreckage 1. Guide the traveler through encounters with alien creatures and investigate the areas for hidden discoveries. Collect coins and jewels to spend in shops, unlocking power-ups that support the next part of the expedition.

pages.title: Basketball Rush
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Aim for consecutive baskets in Basketball Rush. Line up shots and use the available power-ups as scoring makes the challenge more demanding. Unlock different ball skins along the way and return to improve your performance through another shooting attempt.

pages.title: Merge 3D - Match 3 Balloons
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Bring a floating house down safely in Merge 3D - Match 3 Balloons. Select balloons to place them in the collection cells, then match three identical objects to remove them. Each completed set frees space and lowers the house closer to the ground.

pages.title: Tralala Connect
pages.creator: AF
pages.description: Match absurd character tiles in Tralala Connect. Find identical Italian Brainrot meme pictures and connect the available pairs to clear the arrangement. Work through fifteen levels and pursue all forty-five stars as the tile layouts become more demanding.

pages.title: Block Blast 2048
pages.creator: Bubble Shooter
pages.description: Build larger numbered pieces in Block Blast 2048. Combine blocks displaying the same value to create a higher-numbered block and increase the score. Keep arranging useful matches as the board develops toward the next value you want to produce.

pages.title: Obby: Pogo Parkour!
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Bounce across obstacle courses in Obby: Pogo Parkour! Tilt the pogo stick, adjust the character's position in the air, and time jumps between landing areas. Buy and upgrade sticks to tackle further stages and compete for a stronger place on the leaderboard.

pages.title: High Heel Design
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Create a customized pair of shoes in High Heel Design. Work with the available fashion elements to shape and decorate high heels, combining details into your preferred design. Compare the selected pieces as the shoes develop into a finished footwear creation.

pages.title: Sprunki Shooter 2025
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Open the exit in Sprunki Shooter 2025 by clearing a route through each level. Shoot enemies and obstacles, collecting every scattered diamond needed for the door. Avoid threats that remain in the path and reach the unlocked exit to continue.

pages.title: Power Light
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Restore an electrical connection in Power Light. Rearrange the tiles so power can travel through a continuous route to the bulb. Check how the sections line up and complete the circuit to illuminate the light and finish the level.

pages.title: My Parking Lot
pages.creator: Guangzhou Yomitoo Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Untangle a vehicle jam in My Parking Lot. Choose which cars can leave safely and send them toward the exit without striking another vehicle. Clear the whole lot to complete the puzzle, moving or zooming the view when the arrangement needs closer inspection.

pages.title: Urban Assault Force
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Join a counter-terrorism team in Urban Assault Force. Fight through city encounters with first-person weapons, using the scope to line up shots and switching firearms as needed. Pick up equipment and rescue people with the interaction control while completing the operation.

pages.title: Madness Driver Vertigo City
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Explore a stunt-filled city in Madness Driver Vertigo City. Drive sports cars over ramps, collect gems, and try the amusement-park activities between races. Choose solo or two-player play, customize a car, and compete with a friend or roam in free-drive mode.

pages.title: Combo Jump
pages.creator: DAPALAB
pages.description: Bounce through rotating platforms in Combo Jump. Work through the openings and smash through suitable sections while progressing toward the finish. Build combos and earn money during the descent to unlock more locations for the next platform challenge.

pages.title: Monster Match-3
pages.creator: Rocket Studio
pages.description: Match monster pieces across a puzzle journey in Monster Match-3. Bring identical characters together to make combinations and work through the requirements of each stage. Choose matches that improve the next arrangement as you advance to further levels.

pages.title: Trash Factory
pages.creator: Digital Will Inc.
pages.description: Route waste to the correct containers in Trash Factory. Tap switches to redirect items along the conveyor paths, keeping each kind of rubbish on course for its matching bin. Fill containers to advance and maintain accurate sorting to keep the factory manager satisfied.

pages.title: Dress Up Games
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Style virtual models for six different events in Dress Up Games. Choose an occasion such as a prom, wedding, shopping trip, or award show, then browse its separate wardrobe. Combine clothing and accessories to complete an outfit suited to the selected appearance.

pages.title: Take Apart
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Reorganize weight plates in Take Apart. Move barbell pieces onto the racks, placing identical colors together and using empty positions to make room. Plan which pieces to shift first so the remaining colors can also reach a matching stack.

pages.title: Ball Tales - The Holy Treasure
pages.creator: Unico Studio
pages.description: Recover stolen treasure in Ball Tales - The Holy Treasure. Guide the ball heroes through traps, spikes, and blades while solving puzzles along the route. Move and jump with the keyboard to continue their pursuit of the warriors carrying the treasure away.

pages.title: Army Machine Transporter Truck
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Carry military equipment between destinations in Army Machine Transporter Truck. Drive the loaded army vehicle through each assignment using the movement keys. Complete the transport job to unlock another level and continue the sequence of military cargo deliveries.

pages.title: The Besties Tattooist
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Create body-art designs for Mia, Emma, and Ava in The Besties Tattooist. Choose a character and the requested back or thigh placement, then apply a selected design. Flowers, birds, and other patterns provide options for completing each girl's tattoo session.

pages.title: Color Gravity
pages.creator: XiferGames
pages.description: Reverse the pull of gravity in Color Gravity. Click to change your route, collecting items that match your color and avoiding obstacles of other colors. Read the changing layout ahead as later levels present more difficult arrangements to pass through.

pages.title: The Runaway Cats
pages.creator: Brave Giant LTD
pages.description: Trap a clever feline in The Runaway Cats. Select tiles to close possible routes, remembering that the cat moves after each choice you make. Narrow its options until no exit remains, using obstacle boosters when another barrier could complete the enclosure.

pages.title: Bffs Hello Halloween
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Prepare a festive makeover in Bffs Hello Halloween. Paint Halloween designs on the friends' faces, choose outfits that complement the makeup, and decorate a pumpkin. Combine colors, patterns, and accessories to finish the group's costumes and seasonal display.

pages.title: Sniper 3D
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Line up distant shots in Sniper 3D. Locate enemy targets and fire accurately to complete the shooting objectives, waiting for a clear opportunity when necessary. Work through more than a hundred stages built around the sniper's precision-based encounters.

pages.title: Super Race 3D
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Guide a crowd safely to its transport in Super Race 3D. Choose when the group should use escalators or cross busy roads, watching the traffic before letting people advance. Avoid passing vehicles and bring the crowd through the danger zones to the waiting cars.

pages.title: Shapik The Quest
pages.creator: Feig Ltd.
pages.description: Explore a strange world with a small hero and his bee companion in Shapik The Quest. Click objects to investigate scenes, solve riddles, and help the pair continue. Nine levels introduce different creatures and puzzles along their shared journey.

pages.title: Impostor Zombies
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Defend a city's gates with wall-mounted bows in Impostor Zombies. Aim at the approaching monsters and adjust the trajectory and power of each shot. Stop the attackers before they reach the inhabitants, choosing firing angles that reach the next group on the road.

pages.title: Rescue The Gold Fish
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Rescue The Gold Fish is a point and click rescue puzzle. Explore scenes, examine objects up close, and collect items for your inventory. Use the objects and clues you find to solve the puzzles standing between you and the fish.

pages.title: Zombies Shooter Part 2
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: Clear a city of mutated undead in Zombies Shooter Part 2. Fight fire-breathing former firefighters, stone-throwing giants, and fast-moving football players with an assortment of firearms. Move through the streets, switch weapons, and use grenades to handle the different threats.

pages.title: Space Wars Cartoon Coloring
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Paint science-fiction pictures in Space Wars Cartoon Coloring. Choose from eight drawings and a palette of twenty-three colors, then fill the scene with your preferred combination. Work through the details and save the completed artwork when you are ready to finish.

pages.title: Paper Planes
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Follow the central aircraft's direction in Paper Planes. Swipe the way the middle plane points, keeping attention on it rather than the surrounding formation. Score as many correct responses as possible in sixty seconds and compare the daily or weekly result.

pages.title: Frenzy Chicken Shooter 3D
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Complete chicken-shooting assignments in Frenzy Chicken Shooter 3D. Look around with the mouse, select a weapon, and fire at the birds required by the level. Use the zoom control to line up targets before finishing the current hunting objective.

pages.title: Heavy Coach Bus Simulation Game
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Drive a passenger coach between destinations in Heavy Coach Bus Simulation Game. Follow the transport route through city and highway settings, using the keyboard to steer the vehicle. Keep the bus under control as you complete the tourist-travel assignments.

pages.title: Ramp Car Stunts Racing Extreme Car Stunt
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Take vehicles onto elevated stunt courses in Ramp Car Stunts Racing Extreme Car Stunt. Choose Dragon Road or Mega Ramp challenges and drive through twisting tracks with sports cars or a monster truck. Manage each approach to keep the vehicle on the route through the stunts.

pages.title: Coin Master Free Spin and Coin Spin Wheel
pages.creator: yaine
pages.description: Try a resource-themed prize wheel in Coin Master Free Spin and Coin Spin Wheel. Start the wheel, wait for it to settle, and inspect the selected reward section. The game centers on repeating the on-screen spinning activity and checking its results.

pages.title: Battle Area
pages.creator: SDV Imants Klava
pages.description: Recapture a mineral mine on Mars in Battle Area. Explore the occupied site in first person and eliminate the hostile soldiers holding it. Use movement keys and mouse aiming to work through the enemy positions until the mine's defenders have been defeated.

pages.title: Sweet Valentine Memory
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Find romantic picture pairs in Sweet Valentine Memory. Flip tiles to reveal their images and remember where matching items appeared. Clear the board across four levels, trying to finish each arrangement with fewer turns than on the previous attempt.

pages.title: Drifting BMW S1000RR Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild motorcycle scenes in Drifting BMW S1000RR Puzzle. Choose from six images and four layouts, ranging from sixteen to one hundred pieces. Match the bike's details and surrounding picture sections until the selected BMW S1000RR illustration is complete.

pages.title: Animals Shapes for kids Education
pages.creator: Digi Smile limited
pages.description: Match creatures to their silhouettes in Animals Shapes for kids Education. Compare four animals with the four empty shadow shapes, then place each one in the corresponding space. Filling every outline correctly completes the level and presents another group to identify.

pages.title: Spider Santa Claus
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Swing a web-slinging Santa past hazards in Spider Santa Claus. Fire a web to gain a swinging route around obstacles and keep as much of the character intact as possible. Reach the destination to restore Santa before continuing to another level.

pages.title: Santa Hill Climbing
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Carry Santa across uneven roads in Santa Hill Climbing. Control acceleration and reverse movement to handle the bumps while conserving fuel. Gather gifts along the way and try to cover more ground before the drive comes to an end.

pages.title: Circus Mystery
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Throw knives into a rotating circus target in Circus Mystery. Time each launch to hit an empty section without striking a knife already embedded in the circle. Watch for changes in its rotation as you keep the throwing sequence going.

pages.title: Halloween Monster Clicker
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Stop falling creatures in Halloween Monster Clicker. Click each monster before it reaches the ground, switching attention between the threats descending into the scene. Keep removing them as more arrive to continue the Halloween-themed clicking challenge.

pages.title: FZ Zig Zag
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Guide a moving line across a block-built path in FZ Zig Zag. Tap to change its direction at the corners, keeping the line aligned with the route. Continue farther without letting a badly timed turn take it off the blocks.

pages.title: Birds Mahjong Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Clear bird pictures from a tile board in Birds Mahjong Deluxe. Select identical pairs whose tiles each have at least two neighboring sides open. Removing a pair changes which pieces are accessible, so look for another available match in the remaining arrangement.

pages.title: Koala
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Keep a kart on its route in Koala. Click the left mouse button to turn, timing the changes of direction around the course. Try to extend the drive without a crash as another corner approaches the moving kart.

pages.title: Coin Slope
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Steer a rolling coin along a raised route in Coin Slope. Change direction with the left and right controls to follow the developing road. Keep the coin on the surface without falling off, then press Space to restart another attempt.

pages.title: Assault Fury
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fight through forty shooting stages in Assault Fury. Face different enemy types with a selection of firearms, using the first-person view to aim during encounters. Improve the character's equipment through upgrades and prepare for the opponents waiting farther into the campaign.

pages.title: Moon Defender
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Protect a moon base from incoming space rocks in Moon Defender. Aim at asteroids and destroy them before they reach the installation. Watch the weapon's heat while firing, leaving room for it to cool instead of overheating during a dangerous approach.

pages.title: Spin The Color
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Match the colors of approaching balls in Spin The Color. Change the receiving color to pair each incoming ball with its corresponding target. Keep choosing the correct match as the action continues to extend the run and increase the score.

pages.title: Superhero Toy Shop
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help Rachel prepare her new store in Superhero Toy Shop. Create the remaining superhero-princess toys and place them in the shop for its opening. Work through the toy-making choices to finish the collection before the store welcomes its customers.

pages.title: Wheelie Challenge
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Keep the front wheel raised in Wheelie Challenge. Balance on the back wheel and try to extend the wheelie's duration through each attempt, maintaining control for as long as you can.

pages.title: Black & White Ski Challenge
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Steer two winter-sports characters together in Black & White Ski Challenge. Control both skiers at the same time, paying attention to how each character's left and right turns differ. Coordinate their routes and keep the pair moving to build a stronger score.

pages.title: Soldier Legend
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Fight aliens and monsters in Soldier Legend. Move through action encounters and use the soldier's firearms to defeat the opponents ahead. The game combines shooting and close confrontations, with new groups of enemies challenging the character along the adventure.

pages.title: Old Macdonald Farm
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Explore an interactive countryside scene in Old Macdonald Farm. Move animals, greet the farmer, and investigate activities around the barn and stable. There is no required objective, so choose which cow, sheep, pig, horse, or chicken interaction to try next.

pages.title: 3thamthmy Adventure
pages.creator: Marc Arnaud
pages.description: Match character pieces across a puzzle journey in 3thamthmy Adventure. Form combinations of identical figures and work toward the different target assigned to each level. Use the available blasting options when they help clear the remaining pieces needed for the objective.

pages.title: White Party Surprise
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Dress four princesses for a themed gathering in White Party Surprise. Choose white dresses, skirts, or tops for Elsa, Ariel, Rapunzel, and Cinderella. Complete their coordinated outfits with bags, hair accessories, and pearl jewelry from the available wardrobes.

pages.title: Auroras Birthday Ball
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Prepare a celebration for a sleeping princess in Auroras Birthday Ball. Help Belle and Mulan choose a present, then style Aurora for her party. Compare the available clothing and accessories to complete the birthday girl's appearance for the ball.

pages.title: Doodle God Good Old Times
pages.creator: JoyBits
pages.description: Discover a medieval world through combinations in Doodle God Good Old Times. Mix elements to create people, buildings, tools, and inventions associated with a kingdom of peasants and knights. Each discovery adds another possibility as the world develops toward castles and more advanced creations.

pages.title: Pinball Breakout
pages.creator: Fish Pond Studio
pages.description: Aim bouncing balls through generated layouts in Pinball Breakout. Release shots toward the blocks and use rebounds to reach more targets in the same volley. Clear the arrangement to continue into another level built around the combination of ball physics and block breaking.

pages.title: Annies Tailor Course
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Learn dressmaking with a designer in Annies Tailor Course. Help Annie work through the steps for creating three different dresses during her class. Complete the available design choices and tailoring activities to finish the collection of outfits.

pages.title: Towers vs Ice cubes
pages.creator: ESERGAMES
pages.description: Build defenses against moving frozen blocks in Towers vs Ice cubes. Spend mana to place towers and destroy the cubes before they escape the route. Choose positions that keep the blocks under attack while managing the resources needed for more defenses.

pages.title: Easter Cookies
pages.creator: GAMEGOS
pages.description: Prepare treats for a seasonal celebration in Easter Cookies. Join the kitchen activity and work through the cookie-making steps for the party. Select the required ingredients and tools as the desserts develop into a finished batch for the Easter gathering.

pages.title: Platforms 4 Colors
pages.creator: MomentsGames
pages.description: Choose the next landing by color in Platforms 4 Colors. Tap the button corresponding to the upcoming platform to make the character jump onto it. Continue matching the sequence correctly and move upward through another set of colored platforms.

pages.title: Princess Sale Rush
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help a princess shop before the discounts disappear in Princess Sale Rush. Accompany her and her friends around the mall, comparing clothing for a new outfit. Choose the pieces you want her to buy and complete the look during the shopping trip.

pages.title: Butterfly Kyodai
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clear matching butterfly pictures in Butterfly Kyodai. Find two identical images and connect the available pair, removing them from the arrangement. Continue checking the remaining tiles for another connection until the board's butterfly collection has been cleared.

pages.title: Princesses At Ski
pages.creator: Next Vision Solutions
pages.description: Prepare royal travelers for winter sports in Princesses At Ski. Choose clothing and accessories from the available wardrobe after the group reaches its hotel. Put together a ski outfit for each princess so they can continue their snowy holiday.

pages.title: Princess College Dorm Deco
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Decorate a shared student room in Princess College Dorm Deco. Choose wallpaper, a bunk bed, and other room details, comparing how the pieces work together. Finish a dorm design that gives the princesses a coordinated space for the new college year.

pages.title: Princesses Halloween Fashion
pages.creator: Next Vision Solutions
pages.description: Create costumes for a royal group in Princesses Halloween Fashion. Browse the available clothing and combine pieces into a Halloween look for each princess. Finish the outfits and accessories so the characters are ready to join their seasonal party.
